name: 心境障碍问卷
instructions: 请回忆您一生中是否曾有过以下一段时间（而非现在），并据实回答。
instructionsEn: Please recall whether you have ever had a period of time in your life (not now) when you felt the following ways, and answer honestly.
license: Hirschfeld 等编制，可免费使用，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 您是否曾感到自己过于兴奋，或感觉“特别棒”，与平常的自己判若两人？
items.textEn: Have you ever felt overly excited, or felt so good that you seemed like a completely different person than usual?

items.text: 您是否曾异常急躁易怒，向别人大喊大叫，甚至挑起争吵或打架？
items.textEn: Have you ever been so unusually irritable or short-tempered that you shouted at others, or even started arguments or fights?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时自信得多？
items.textEn: Have you ever been much more self-confident than usual?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时睡得少很多，却不觉得困？
items.textEn: Have you ever slept much less than usual without feeling tired?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时健谈得多，或说话速度明显加快？
items.textEn: Have you ever been much more talkative than usual, or spoken noticeably faster?

items.text: 您是否曾思维跳跃、想法一个接一个，脑子里慢不下来？
items.textEn: Have you ever had racing thoughts, one idea after another, unable to slow your mind down?

items.text: 您是否曾很容易被周围事物分散注意力，难以集中？
items.textEn: Have you ever been easily distracted by things around you, so that it was hard to concentrate?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时精力充沛得多？
items.textEn: Have you ever had much more energy than usual?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时活跃得多，做了比平常多很多的事情？
items.textEn: Have you ever been much more active than usual, doing many more things than usual?

items.text: 您是否曾比平时更爱交际或更外向（例如半夜给朋友打电话）？
items.textEn: Have you ever been more social or outgoing than usual (for example, telephoning friends in the middle of the night)?

items.text: 您是否曾对性的兴趣比平时大得多？
items.textEn: Have you ever been much more interested in sex than usual?

items.text: 您是否曾做过一些与您平时不同、别人可能认为是过分、愚蠢或冒险的事情？
items.textEn: Have you ever done things that were different from your usual self and that others might have considered excessive, foolish, or risky?

items.text: 您是否曾因乱花钱使您或您的家人陷入困境？
items.textEn: Have you ever put yourself or your family in trouble by spending money recklessly?

items.text: 上述这些情况是否曾在同一时期内同时出现？
items.textEn: Have all of these situations ever happened during the same period of time?

items.text: 这些问题给您造成多大程度的困扰？
items.textEn: To what extent have these problems bothered you?

screenGate.positiveDescription: 结果提示双相谱系障碍的可能性，建议进一步接受专业精神科评估。
screenGate.negativeDescription: 结果未提示双相谱系障碍的典型特征。本问卷仅用于筛查，不能替代专业诊断。
